comparison.objective: Set a mould core into the drag and lower the cope between alignment posts; candidate breaks and recovers four HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Lift and precisely seat a core, then align and lower a large mould half between guide posts versus millimetre-scale mandrel insertion, stabilized hammer impact, and fragment search/recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Core seated and cope successfully closed between posts versus four notch fractures, four tangs in a tray, retained inserts, no damage, and stable tool release.
comparison.reason: Both require alignment and insertion, but mould assembly tests heavy-part seating and guided closure, not controlled impact fracture or fragment containment. Exact seating, collision, and damage thresholds are not given.
